# S63 — Landing: merge detection, branch cleanup and run pruning

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**2026-10-20** — Proposed, awaiting owner (2026-10-20 review), landing.merge-detect: when a project's HEAD changes (record 66's signal), run one merged-branch check for that project's committed runs; no extra git reads while HEAD is unchanged.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Merged branches should be detected and offered for cleanup (decision 49, list-and-detect; docs/dashboard.md:104). Runs are kept until landed (decision 36). Retention keeps the latest 100 finished runs but never removes a run whose branch is not landed (docs/state.md:200-207). runrec.Store.Prune already takes a landed predicate and removes nothing without one (internal/runrec/store.go:178-182). Nothing calls Prune yet; the only callers are in internal/runrec/runrec_test.go:375-381.
Decision 66 (head-only) fixes the change signal that refresh reads: git rev-parse HEAD per project. It does not decide whether a merge check may run.
docs/boundaries.md:17 says landing is outside ork in v1. That conflicts with decision 49, which is the one to follow. The boundaries row is stale.
Decided: record 128 (landing.merge-detect). When a project's HEAD changes (record 66's signal), ork runs one merged-branch check for that project's committed runs. While HEAD is unchanged it reads nothing more. This adds one git command beyond record 66's head-only signal, with the owner's agreement.

## Failing tests

- TestPruneKeepsTheLatestHundredFinishedRuns: keeps 100 and removes the oldest finished runs beyond that only when landed (extends TestPruneKeepsTheLatestFinishedAndOnlyRemovesLanded, internal/runrec/runrec_test.go:355).
- TestPruneNeverRemovesUnlandedOrActiveRuns: a nil landed removes nothing (internal/runrec/store.go:178-181); an active run stays.
- TestLandedIsTrueOnlyForAMergedBranch: a branch that is an ancestor of HEAD is landed; an unmerged branch is not (fake git).
- TestRefreshReadsOnlyHeadPerProject: a dashboard refresh runs only git rev-parse HEAD per project (decision 66). The merged-branch check runs only when HEAD changed (record 128), never on an unchanged refresh.
- TestMergeCheckRunsOnlyWhenHeadChanged: a refresh with the same HEAD runs no merged-branch check; a changed HEAD runs it once for that project.
- TestMergedBranchIsOfferedNotRemoved: a merged branch gets a cleanup offer, and no worktree is removed without the owner (decision 36).
